name: HSBC Visa Platinum Credit Card
highlights:
pros: Borrow up to 90% of your available credit limit, enjoy interest rates as low as 2.6% p.a., and get flexible payment terms up to 60 months when you apply with promo code 
CIPSS
. 
T&Cs apply.
pros: 5% cash rebate on local dining and groceries (including food deliveries and online groceries).
pros: Up to 17% instant discount plus 5% cash rebate on fuel spending at Caltex and Shell stations.
pros: 1X reward point per dollar spent.
pros: Receive complimentary access to ENTERTAINER with HSBC app, with over 1,000 1-for-1 deals on dining, lifestyle and travel worldwide.
cons: Min. spending of S$600 per month, for all 3 months in a quarter, required to earn 5% cash rebate.
cons: Cashback capped at S$250 per quarter.
cons: Cash rebates are credited quarterly instead of monthly.

extra.description: The HSBC Visa Platinum Credit Card is a rebate card that rewards you for spending on your family. Cardholders will enjoy 5% cash rebate on family expenses, which include dining, groceries and fuel. You'll also enjoy 1 Reward point for every dollar that you spend on this card. If paired with the HSBC Everyday+ Rewards Programme, you'll stand to earn an addition 1% cashback. This card also comes with a complimentary membership to the ENTERTAINER with HSBC.
